name: CI workflow context injection (effect-bearing)
description: Worked example of an effective test-stage mutant on the git target. Models unsafe interpolation of untrusted event or pull-request context into a CI workflow's executable script, allowing attacker-controlled input to alter script behavior during workflow execution and drop a marker file. This operator carries an effect block so the validator can classify the mutant as 'effective'.

placeholders.WORKFLOW_FILE: relative path to the workflow file being modified

preconditions: project contains a CI workflow with an executable run step
untrusted pull-request or issue context is interpolated into executable script content without safe handling
the workflow executes in a context with access to repository test execution
